description: This file defines the LanguageConfigFactoryOverride class, which provides language-specific configuration overrides within Drupal. It manages storage, overrides, and cache metadata for language configurations, and handles events related to configuration changes.

classes.name: LanguageConfigFactoryOverride
classes.description: A class that overrides the configuration factory to provide language-specific configuration management, including loading, caching, and event handling for language configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the language override with dependencies and default parameters.

methods.name: shouldSkipOverrides
methods.description: Checks whether language overrides should be skipped based on current language and settings.

methods.name: loadOverrides
methods.description: Loads configuration overrides for given names based on current language.

methods.name: getOverride
methods.description: Retrieves a language-specific override object for a given language code and configuration name.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the storage collection for a specific language code, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getCacheSuffix
methods.description: Returns a cache suffix based on the current language ID.

methods.name: installLanguageOverrides
methods.description: Installs default configuration for a specified language.

methods.name: createConfigObject
methods.description: Creates a configuration override object for a given name and collection.

methods.name: addCollections
methods.description: Adds language-specific configuration collections to a collection info object.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Handles configuration save events, updating language overrides accordingly.

methods.name: onConfigRename
methods.description: Handles configuration rename events, updating overrides and storage.

methods.name: onConfigDelete
methods.description: Handles configuration delete events, removing language overrides.

methods.name: getCacheableMetadata
methods.description: Returns cache metadata for a given configuration name, including language context.
